description: Microsoft Word is open with 'oncology_protocol_raw.docx', a Phase III clinical trial protocol for a KRAS G12C NSCLC study. The document is entirely unformatted plain text. You are a medical writer at a contract research organization (CRO) responsible for formatting this protocol to ICH E6(R2) GCP standards before regulatory submission. Complete ALL of the following: (1) Apply 'Heading 1' style to the 8 numbered top-level section headers: 'PROTOCOL SYNOPSIS', '1. INTRODUCTION AND RATIONALE', '2. STUDY OBJECTIVES AND ENDPOINTS', '3. STUDY DESIGN', '4. PATIENT SELECTION', '5. STUDY TREATMENTS', '6. STUDY ASSESSMENTS', '7. STATISTICAL ANALYSIS PLAN', '8. ETHICAL CONSIDERATIONS'; (2) Apply 'Heading 2' style to all numbered sub-section headers (e.g., '1.1 Background and Disease Overview', '2.1 Primary Objective', '4.1 Inclusion Criteria', '6.1 Schedule of Assessments', '7.1 Sample Size and Power', '8.1 Good Clinical Practice', and all others); (3) Insert a Table of Contents at the beginning of the document before the title; (4) In sub-section 6.1 Schedule of Assessments, insert a table with at least 3 columns and at least 6 data rows representing the visit schedule from the protocol; (5) Add a footer to all pages containing the text 'CONFIDENTIAL - HRZ-NSCLC-301 - For Regulatory Use Only'; (6) Save the file as 'oncology_protocol_final.docx' in the Desktop\WordTasks folder.
